Definition: Cholon, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Holon is the name of two towns, one in Judah and one in Moab, and both appear in the lists of judgment and inheritance. Joshua gives a Holon in the hill country to Judah, another Holon is given to the priests as a city of refuge, and Jeremiah pronounces judgment on Holon in Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Holons show how one name can stand in promise and in judgment, and the difference is always whether a people obeys God.
